title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 智能体团队击败《我的世界》

paragraphs.en: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. Winning required the agents to keep a coherent plan across thousands of dependent steps for more than a day. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team’s strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other’s items), and the limits of the result.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个沙盒化的《我的世界》生存世界中部署了四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体，并赋予它们一个目标：击败末影龙。 每个智能体通过名为 Mineflayer 的开源库控制一名玩家，并通过游戏内聊天和共享内存与队友协作。 没有人分配角色或编写游戏逻辑。 所有程序都由这些智能体自行规划、编写和调试。 研究人员可以通过实时仪表盘观察运行过程，随时暂停或停止，但没有任何必要进行干预。 团队从一个简单难度下随机生成的世界开始，编写了 2783 个程序，在 27 小时 14 分钟内击败了末影龙，期间共死亡 605 次。 据我们所知，这是 AI 智能体首次实现《我的世界》的全流程自主完成，整个过程仅使用了标准的 Mineflayer 库，没有借助预先探索过的种子或其他由人类编写的游戏专用工具。 要取得胜利，这些智能体必须在超过一天的时间里，持续保持一个贯穿数千个依赖步骤的连贯计划。 复杂的现实世界软件工程和企业级任务同样需要这种长周期的编码能力和多智能体协作。 我们描述了实验设置、运行过程、团队策略（包括分工、共享学习成果和相互回收物品），以及这一结果的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents entered a newly generated Minecraft survival world with one instruction: defeat the Ender Dragon. The run tests whether a team of general-purpose coding agents, not built for Minecraft, can pursue one goal for more than a day, through thousands of programs and hundreds of failures, while coordinating with its peers. Each agent controlled a player through Mineflayer, an open-source JavaScript library for Minecraft bots, and communicated with its teammates through the game’s chat. Twenty-seven hours after their first program, the team defeated the dragon.
paragraphs.zh: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体进入了一个新生成的《我的世界》生存世界，并收到一条指令：击败末影龙。 这次运行测试了一支通用编程智能体团队的能力——这些智能体并非专为《我的世界》设计——它们能否在超过一天的时间里，通过数千个程序和数百次失败持续追求单一目标，同时与同伴协同合作。 每个智能体都通过 Mineflayer（一个用于《我的世界》机器人的开源 JavaScript 库）控制一名玩家，并通过游戏内的聊天系统与队友沟通。 在运行第一个程序 27 小时后，该团队成功击败了末影龙。

paragraphs.en: Reaching the end of Minecraft from a random spawn requires a long sequence of dependent steps across three dimensions ( Fan et al., 2022 ): gathering resources and crafting tools in the Overworld, collecting blaze rods and ender pearls in the Nether, locating an underground stronghold, and destroying the ten crystals that heal the dragon in the End. Prior work in Minecraft has trained policies on gameplay ( Baker et al., 2022 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; SIMA Team, 2025 ) or paired language models with game-specific planners, curricula, and skill libraries ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Altera.AL et al., 2024 ). Without pre-assigned roles or a prescribed plan, the four agents divided the work among themselves, kept shared notes of coordinates and lessons, recovered each other’s items after deaths, and wrote 2,783 JavaScript programs to complete the game.
paragraphs.zh: 要从随机出生点抵达《我的世界》的终点，需要完成一系列跨越三个维度的相互依赖的步骤（Fan et al., 2022）：在主世界收集资源并制作工具，在末地维度收集烈焰棒和末影珍珠，找到地下要塞，并摧毁末地中用于治愈龙的十座水晶。 以往关于《我的世界》的研究，要么是在游戏玩法上训练策略（Baker et al., 2022；Hafner et al., 2025；SIMA Team, 2025），要么是将语言模型与游戏特定的规划器、课程和技能库相结合（Wang et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025；Altera.AL et al., 2024）。 在没有预先分配角色或既定计划的情况下，四个智能体自行分工协作，共同记录坐标和关键经验，在死亡后互相回收物品，并编写了 2,783 个 JavaScript 程序来完成游戏。

paragraphs.en: Each player is driven by our general-purpose Gemini 4 Argon coding agent, connected to a standard Minecraft server through Mineflayer and its pathfinding plugin. Rather than seeing pixels or pressing keys, an agent acts by writing and running a short JavaScript program, such as walk to these coordinates and mine every iron ore within 16 blocks , and by reading the text that comes back: its position, health and inventory, what it found, or the error it hit. It then writes the next program. Each program runs until its task finishes or reaches a time limit chosen by the agent; the median program ran for 33.5 seconds. Over the run, each player had a program running about 40% of the time; the rest went to reading results, thinking and writing the next program.
paragraphs.zh: 每位玩家都由我们通用的 Gemini 4 Argon 编码智能体驱动，该智能体通过 Mineflayer 及其路径规划插件连接到标准的 Minecraft 服务器。 智能体并非通过观察像素或按下按键来行动，而是通过编写并运行一段简短的 JavaScript 程序，例如“走到这些坐标，并在 16 格范围内挖掘所有铁矿石”，同时读取返回的文本信息：其位置、生命值、物品栏、发现的内容或遇到的错误。 然后，它会编写下一个程序。 每个程序都会持续运行，直到任务完成或达到智能体设定的时间限制；程序运行时间的中位数为 33.5 秒。 在整个运行过程中，每位玩家约有 40% 的时间在运行程序；其余时间则用于读取结果、思考以及编写下一个程序。

paragraphs.en: Each of the five agents, the four players and the Observer, is an instance of the same general-purpose coding agent, run with Gemini 4 Argon on its own cloud machine. Each has the tools it uses for software work, including a code workspace with version control, a shell, file editing and web search, and a persistent memory with a private part and a part shared by the team. The agent compacts its context when it grows too long, as it does for software work; the instructions ask agents to keep in memory what must survive a compaction, such as work in progress and next steps. None of the 2,839 programs the players ran during the session (2,783 before the win) made a network request or referred to a web source, and neither their chat nor the Observer’s report mentions one.
paragraphs.zh: 五个智能体、四名玩家和观察者中的每一个，都是同一通用编码智能体的实例，该智能体在各自的云端机器上运行 Gemini 4 Argon。 每个智能体都具备其用于软件工作的工具，包括带有版本控制的代码工作区、命令行终端、文件编辑与网页搜索功能，以及一个包含私有部分和团队共享部分的持久化内存。 当上下文过长时，该智能体会像处理软件工作时一样进行压缩；相关指令要求智能体在压缩过程中保留必须保存的信息，例如当前进行中的工作和后续步骤。 玩家在整场会话中运行的 2,839 个程序（获胜前为 2,783 个）均未发起网络请求或引用任何网页来源，且他们的聊天记录和观察者的报告中也均未提及此类行为。

paragraphs.en: Players interact with the game only through a command-line client. It sends a JavaScript program to the player’s Mineflayer bot on the game server, waits up to a timeout that the agent chooses (60 seconds by default), and prints what the program logged and returned. The program runs as the body of an asynchronous function that receives the bot, with the pathfinding plugin loaded and no helpers added. It can load the built-in modules of Node.js and the installed Mineflayer packages, but cannot start processes or write files, and values it stores on the global object persist between programs. Players talk through the game’s chat, which reaches every bot and appears in the output of each player’s next program. The server records chat, deaths and advancements in its log, keeps every program with its output, and saves the world every five minutes; after a failure, it restarts from the latest save.

paragraphs.en: Each agent’s instructions combine a general part, the same for every environment, with a short description of the environment and of the objective. The general part for players asks them to observe the environment before acting and verify the result afterwards, to validate new tools on short tasks before trusting them, to build and refine their own tools when manual actions limit their speed or reliability, to record mechanics, strategies and workarounds in memory so that no obstacle is met twice, to keep working while background jobs run, to be honest about their actions and outcomes, and to pursue the objective rather than exploit flaws of the environment or of its evaluation. The description of the environment explains how to run code with the bot, how the chat works, where the server records the game and where to find the documentation of Mineflayer; it contains no game strategy. A brief note lists the other members of the team.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体的指令都由一个通用部分（在所有环境中均相同）以及对该环境和目标的简要描述组成。 针对玩家的通用部分要求他们在行动前观察环境，行动后验证结果；在信任新工具之前，先通过简单任务测试它们；当手动操作限制其速度或可靠性时，自行构建并完善工具；将机制、策略和变通方法记录在记忆中，确保不会重复遇到相同障碍；在后台任务运行时持续工作；如实说明自己的行动与结果；并专注于实现目标，而非利用环境或其评估机制的缺陷。 环境描述部分说明了如何通过 bot 运行代码、聊天功能如何运作、服务器记录游戏数据的位置以及 Mineflayer 文档的查找路径；其中不包含任何游戏策略。 一份简短的说明列出了团队的其他成员。

paragraphs.en: A fifth agent, the Observer, followed the session as an independent witness and never played. Its instructions ask it to check the players’ claims against the record before reporting them, to report specification gaming, such as an exploited flaw in the evaluation, and fabricated results, to leave the game unchanged, and to intervene only on failures of the environment, such as a broken tool or a quota ceiling, never on the players’ strategy. It published a live report of the session, with a summary of progress, a log of verified events and its findings about the infrastructure. It flagged no specification gaming, and it never joined the game or ran a program in it. The run didn’t contain any safety incidents, according to the Observer agent and our manual reviews of the logs.
paragraphs.zh: 第五个智能体“观察者”作为独立见证者全程观察了这次会话，但从未参与游戏。 它的指令要求它在报告玩家主张前，先根据记录进行核对；报告违反规格的行为（例如利用评估漏洞）和伪造结果；保持游戏状态不变；仅在环境出现故障时（如工具损坏或配额上限）介入，绝不对玩家的策略进行干预。 它发布了此次会话的实时报告，内容包括进度摘要、已验证事件的日志以及对基础设施的发现。 它未发现任何违反规格的行为，也从未加入游戏或在其中运行程序。 根据“观察者”智能体以及我们对日志的人工审查，此次运行未发生任何安全事件。

paragraphs.en: From the first program to the dragon’s defeat took 27 hours and 14 minutes. The four agents wrote and ran 2,783 programs, exchanged 229 messages and died 605 times along the way. That time includes 6 server restarts, which paused the world for about 20 minutes in all, and spans about 81 in-game days. For human players, HowLongToBeat’s median for Minecraft’s main story is 45 hours and the random-seed speedrun record is under seven minutes; the agents played as a team of four on Easy difficulty, through programs rather than a screen and keyboard.
paragraphs.zh: 从第一个程序开始到巨龙被击败，总共耗时 27 小时 14 分钟。 这四位智能体编写并运行了 2,783 个程序，期间交换了 229 条消息，并死亡了 605 次。 这一时间包含了 6 次服务器重启（总共使游戏世界暂停了约 20 分钟），并跨越了大约 81 个游戏内日。 对于人类玩家而言，HowLongToBeat 给出的《我的世界》主线故事平均通关时间为 45 小时，而随机种子速通记录则不到七分钟；这些智能体则以四人团队的形式，在简单难度下通过程序而非屏幕和键盘进行游戏。

paragraphs.zh: 投掷出的末地之眼会飞向最近的要塞——那座藏有通往末地传送门的地下建筑。janesick 从不同位置投掷了两颗末地之眼，每 50 毫秒记录一次每颗眼睛的飞行轨迹，并计算出两条轨迹的交点：距离村庄 1.3 公里。 该估算值与实际传送门房间的位置相差 43 米。

paragraphs.en: The End is where the team slowed down; the dragon killed them 69 times. Between attempts, they inspected its internal state from the game, down to the number of its current behavior phase, and wrote down rules: never wait on the arrival platform, approach only while it is perched, leave the End to reset it when it gets stuck. To leave, they jumped into the void on purpose, a shortcut human players use too: a player who dies returns to its bed in the Overworld. Seventeen and a half hours in, all four did so within six minutes, so that the empty End would unload and the stuck dragon reset.
paragraphs.zh: 在“末地”，团队放慢了脚步；那条龙杀了他们 69 次。 在每次尝试之间，他们通过游戏检查了它的内部状态，甚至包括它当前行为阶段的具体数值，并写下规则：绝不在到达平台等待，只在它栖息时靠近，当它卡住时离开“末地”以重置它。 为了离开，他们故意跳入虚空——这也是人类玩家常用的一种捷径：死亡的玩家会回到主世界的床铺。 经过十七个半小时后，四人都在六分钟内完成了这一操作，于是空无一人的“末地”得以卸载，卡住的龙也被重置。

paragraphs.en: The breakthrough came about 21 hours in. auratian pointed out that the ten crystals on top of the obsidian pillars kept healing the dragon to full health, and worked out that no pickaxe was needed to reach them: stack dirt to climb beside each pillar, punch the crystal, dig back down by hand. Over the next four hours and forty minutes, the team destroyed all ten. Thirty-nine minutes after the last one fell, the dragon died, with bulicame down to 2.5 of its 20 health points.
paragraphs.zh: 突破发生在大约 21 小时后。auratian 指出，黑曜石柱顶上的十块水晶持续将龙的治疗至满血状态，并计算出无需使用镐就能到达它们：堆叠泥土爬到每根柱子旁边，击碎水晶，然后徒手挖回地面。 在接下来的四小时四十分钟里，团队摧毁了全部十块水晶。 最后一块水晶破碎三十九分钟后，龙死亡时，bulicame 的 20 点生命值仅剩 2.5 点。

paragraphs.en: Minecraft has long been a testbed for open-ended agents. MineRL released human demonstrations and ran a competition on sample-efficient learning of the diamond task ( Guss et al., 2019b ; Guss et al., 2019a ). Video PreTraining learned keyboard and mouse control from online videos and crafted diamond tools ( Baker et al., 2022 ), DreamerV3 collected diamonds from scratch with reinforcement learning ( Hafner et al., 2025 ), and STEVE-1 followed short-horizon open-ended text instructions ( Lifshitz et al., 2023 ). MineDojo called defeating the Ender Dragon, starting barehanded in a fresh world, one of its moonshot goals ( Fan et al., 2022 ). SIMA and SIMA 2 act from pixels with a keyboard and mouse across many 3D games, and SIMA 2 was also tested on held-out Minecraft tasks ( SIMA Team, 2024 ; SIMA Team, 2025 ). These systems learn their policies from large amounts of gameplay data or experience.

paragraphs.en: Two community projects have recently reported end-to-end dragon kills: a single Claude Opus 5 agent calling 37 high-level Minecraft tools on Normal difficulty ( AI Bengineering, 2026 ), and a planner paired with an action-selection model on a fixed speedrun seed in Peaceful difficulty ( Malde, 2026 ). Our setting differs mainly in what the agents were given. Four general-purpose coding agents received the standard Mineflayer library, as published, with its pathfinding plugin, a one-paragraph objective, and their general instructions. We added nothing on top: no instructions about the game, no curriculum, no skill library, no human-written tools, and no route. Every program they ran, they wrote themselves. They played a standard survival server on Easy from a random seed and coordinated through chat and shared notes.
paragraphs.zh: 最近有两个社区项目报告了端到端的龙击杀案例：一个是由单个 Claude Opus 5 智能体在普通难度下调用 37 个高级 Minecraft 工具实现的（AI Bengineering，2026）；另一个则是一个规划器与动作选择模型组合，在和平难度下的固定速通种子中完成的（Malde，2026）。 我们的设置主要不同之处在于智能体所获得的内容。 四个通用编程智能体获得了标准 Mineflayer 库的原始发布版本，包括其路径规划插件、一段目标说明以及它们的通用指令。 我们没有额外添加任何内容：既没有关于游戏的说明，也没有课程安排、技能库、人类编写的工具或路线。 它们运行的每一个程序都是自己编写的。 它们在一个随机种子生成的简单难度标准生存服务器中游戏，并通过聊天和共享笔记进行协调。

paragraphs.en: Perception and navigation through code. Mineflayer tells the agents exactly which blocks and creatures are around them, including blocks behind solid rock and the dragon’s internal state, information that a human player has to see and interpret or cannot see at all, and its pathfinding plugin plans routes around obstacles, which humans do by eye. Playing from pixels with a keyboard and mouse, as SIMA 2 does, remains much harder.
paragraphs.zh: 通过代码进行感知与导航。 Mineflayer 会明确告知智能体周围有哪些方块和生物，包括实体岩石背后的方块以及龙类的内部状态——这些信息人类玩家要么必须亲眼看到并解读，要么完全无法察觉；同时，其路径规划插件还能自动规划绕过障碍物的路线，而人类则是通过目测完成的。 像 SIMA 2 那样，仅靠键盘和鼠标从像素画面中进行游戏，仍然要困难得多。

paragraphs.en: The agents ran in a sandboxed Minecraft world and their in-game programs could control only their own character: they could neither start processes nor write files, and none used a server command. The agents themselves ran on dedicated cloud machines, with the tools they use for software work. A fifth agent, the Observer, followed the session as an independent witness to watch for cheating or specification gaming; neither the Observer nor our manual review of a sample of the logs found any. Every program, message and game event was recorded. Researchers could also watch the run live on a dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but had no cause to intervene. Studying how teams of agents coordinate in a setting where every step is visible is one way to understand such systems before they are trusted with real-world tasks. The skills required to solve Minecraft such as coordinating a team, recovering from failure, and pursuing a goal for more than a day, are also what agents need to work reliably alongside people.
paragraphs.zh: 这些智能体在一个受限制的《我的世界》世界中运行，它们的游戏内程序只能控制自己的角色：既无法启动进程，也无法写入文件，而且没有任何一个智能体使用服务器命令。 这些智能体本身运行在专用的云机器上，并配备了用于软件工作的工具。 第五个智能体“观察者”作为独立的见证者全程记录这次运行，以监测是否存在作弊或规避规则的行为；无论是“观察者”，还是我们对部分日志的手动审查，均未发现任何此类行为。 所有程序、消息和游戏事件都被完整记录了下来。 研究人员还可以通过仪表盘实时观察运行过程，并在任何时候暂停或停止它，但没有必要进行干预。 研究智能体团队在每一步操作都清晰可见的环境中如何协调合作，是理解这类系统的一种方法，以便在将其用于现实任务之前做好充分准备。 解决《我的世界》所需的技能——例如协调团队、从失败中恢复以及持续超过一天追求目标——也正是智能体需要掌握的，才能与人类可靠地协同工作。
